notes: price_at_pick = Sky Bet price in the pick record (price file at the lock); sky_bet_price = prices_file row (prices_utc). price_move / drift_warning come from earlier price checks (price_move not pinned). second = ZANS joint-model runner-up (not 2nd favourite), replaced by the next ZANS-chance runner if withdrawn after the lock (second_note); a withdrawn rpr_pick is null with rpr_note. rpr_pick null = no runner has an RPR at trip/going. Absent handicap/drift_warning = false. data_gap true: confidence_capped 6, handoff only.

EVIDENCE: race.evidence = {id, src (sources[].id: origin_path@racing_commit_original, blob_sha1, sha256, captured_utc), pick_sha256 = sha256 of the pick record canonical JSON (sort_keys, (,:), utf-8), price_src, price_row_sha256, longshot_row_sha256 (same hash of the prices-file row)}. evidence_map = which record key or column fed each field. Field in not_verified or unverified_all_races = NOT VERIFIED; unverified reason_fields => confidence_capped 6; price_captured_after_off = prices not verified for that race.

longshot = ZANS best-ranked runner (by ZANS chance) with a held price of 15.00 or more in prices_file, Sky Bet price first, only in fields of 6+; null + longshot_reason otherwise. The pick-time method label is in the pinned pick record (not repeated here); it can differ from the named longshot because prices moved.
FULL file: nothing cut for size. zans_reasons/zans_cautions/data_reasons = none listed means the course method listed none (verified empty), not unavailable.

evidence_manifest.note: Track DNA, methods, course knowledge, runner evidence and past runs for today courses; RP ratings/comments withheld (licence). Full manifest at path.
